purpose: Preview only; no application code changes
commonPrompt:
Create ONE high fidelity Chinese mobile mini-program timetable homepage concept. Portrait screen approximately 1408x3072, matching the aspect ratio of reference image 2, front-facing edge-to-edge, no perspective, no device frame, no mockup board or external labels. Image 1 is the authoritative theme reference / edit target; preserve its visual world and navigation. Image 2 is the recently generated E campus variant and is ONLY the course-card treatment and unified example-content reference; never import E's campus illustration, green navigation palette or header to another theme. Change the course cards to the same principle: a distinct full-height LEFT colored vertical rule, very light same-family fill, deep readable text, names and rooms left-aligned to one inset 7px from the line. Six cards only, each spanning exactly TWO rows. No drop shadows, gray backing, glow, white beveled edges, gradients, or decorative subject icons inside course cards.
Chinese title 拾课课表, semester 2026 秋季学期, week 第4周. Keep theme-specific toolbar and two bottom tabs 课表 and 待办, 课表 active. Keep realistic WeChat capsule and top/bottom safe areas. Do not add weather, statistics, dates, extra tabs or functions.
Exactly seven equal day columns 周一 周二 周三 周四 周五 周六 周日, plus a narrow numbered period column. Exactly eight equal-height period rows, all visible above bottom navigation. Fine grid, precise alignment. Period labels and times:
1 / 08:00 / 08:45
2 / 08:55 / 09:40
3 / 10:00 / 10:45
4 / 10:55 / 11:40
5 / 14:00 / 14:45
6 / 14:55 / 15:40
7 / 16:00 / 16:45
8 / 16:55 / 17:40
Exact course positions and text:
Monday 1–2 高等数学 / A201
Wednesday 1–2 大学物理 / A108
Tuesday 3–4 程序设计 / C402
Friday 3–4 程序设计 / C402
Monday 5–6 大学英语 / B305
Thursday 5–6 体育 / 操场
Weekend columns and rows7–8 empty. Same course identical accent/fill in both appearances. Name semibold, room regular smaller, short 6px gap; four-character course names split naturally into two lines, vertically center name-room group. Strictly fit cards within day/row boundaries with narrow consistent gutters. Preserve legible Chinese, precise hierarchy and substantial timetable area. Reinterpret only the course-card accents, not the entire app. This is a design preview, not a claimed running screenshot.

variants.name: 纸上拾课
variants.prompt: Theme A「纸上拾课」. Preserve warm ivory subtle PAPER texture, quiet brown ink, tasteful Songti Chinese type, centered open-book mark and 拾课课表 title, brick-red 新增, thin ruled semester and week controls, simple paper-style bottom tabs with short red underline. No campus illustrations. Keep the compact original toolbar with 学期、week switch、设置、新增 controls, no big modern pill styling. Course treatment is elegant index-card margin ink: 2.5px muted solid left rule, 3px micro-rounded corners, translucent-looking very pale FLAT paper tints; do not draw other prominent borders. Use warm dusty rose / brick accent for math and sports, parchment ochre for code, muted sage for physics, faded blue-gray for English; ink stays dark warm and readable. Keep subtle paper grain continuous. No card shadow, no gray rectangle behind rounded corners. Preserve system Songti feel for course titles and lining serif numerals for period / room. Restrained handcrafted notebook craft, not ornamental scrapbook. A should stay unmistakably the existing paper theme.

variants.name: 秩序之间
variants.prompt: Theme B「秩序之间」. Preserve Swiss editorial black/white/red identity, oversized bold black 04 week number above the grid with adjacent 第4周, strong left-aligned 拾课课表, precise typography, strict grid, rectangular outlined toolbar buttons 设置、＋新增、学期. Fine neutral gray grid not heavy boxes. Sharp-corner course cards; solid 3px vertical rules on LEFT only, white-to-pale flat fills; red stripe + pale blush math/sports, mustard stripe + pale cream programming, graphite stripe + light neutral gray physics/English. Do not introduce mint-green E header, paper texture, campus art, round pills, playful styling. Course titles and rooms left-aligned with crisp consistent insets and no collision with stripes; medium-bold sans serif names, regular lining room numerals. Timetable readable and precise, big 04 should still leave all8rows visible. Bottom white tab bar black line icons, selected red icon/text and thin straight red underline. Preserve B structure; refine the existing side-stripe design toward the lighter example in image2.

variants.name: 奶油积木
variants.prompt: Theme C「奶油积木」. Preserve clean warm cream background #FFFAF2, dark navy-gray title, orange primary action, very round week control, compact one-line original toolbar with semester, 第4周 switch, outlined 设置 and orange ＋新增; semester is the semester settings entry, do NOT add a separate 学期 button. No campus illustration or paper texture. Course cards keep soft clearly visible ~9px round right corners, while the LEFT edge has a 3px matching accent stripe with rounded ends, around the full block height, not an icon. Light peach fill/terracotta stripe for math and sports, light lavender/muted purple stripe for programming, pale blue/blue stripe for physics, pale yellow/ochre stripe for English. All course text dark, softly warm corresponding hue with high contrast; no dense saturated fills. Preserve slim pale beige grid, airy cream empty cells, single outline around timetable, comfortable typography and rounded cream/orange selected 课表 tab, neutral 待办. No shadows or gray backing anywhere around course cards. This is the existing cream theme, not E with recoloring.

variants.name: 像素课间
variants.prompt: Theme F「像素课间」. Preserve warm-white ground, cobalt-blue Chinese title with yellow pixel underline, original PIXEL ART campus building/trees/cloud/book at upper right, pixel chevrons and icons, squared pixel-outlined toolbar, blue-white grid header, stepped outline ONLY around the entire timetable panel. Course cards: reinterpret the left accent rule as a crisp 3px vertical pixel rail, solid, no dashes, with tiny 2px stepped terminations; tiny stepped right corners. Remove the old full blue outline around each course card so the LEFT RAIL is visually dominant. Very pale blue with strong blue rail math/sport, pale lime with medium grass-green rail code, pale pink with coral-pink rail physics, pale yellow with ochre rail English. Dark cobalt or dark same-family readable course text; clean Chinese body typography, never illegible pixel lettering. No smooth gradients, shadows, bevels or glass. Use actual pixel illustration language in the header, but normal readable names and room labels. Bottom white tabs with blue/yellow pixel icons, blue 课表 selected and short blue line; only two tabs. A coherent retro campus theme, not smooth E art.
